title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Joshua 23: the aged Joshua urges Israel to hold fast to Yahweh.

questions.text: What did Joshua say about himself when he called all Israel together?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 23:2 Joshua says, "I am old and well advanced in years."

answers.text: He was going to lead one more battle
He was going back to Egypt
He was old and well advanced in years
He had been sick for many days

questions.text: The land Joshua allotted reached from the Jordan to where?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:4 says it reached from the Jordan to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

questions.text: What were they to be very courageous to keep and do?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:6 tells them to keep and do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses.

answers.text: All that is written in the book of the law of Moses
The customs of the nations around them
The words of their own elders only

questions.text: What did Joshua forbid them to do with the names of the nations' gods?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:7 says they must not even make mention of the name of their gods.

questions.text: According to Joshua, one man of Israel would chase how many?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:10 says one man of you shall chase a thousand, because Yahweh fights for them.

questions.text: What did Joshua say they should take good heed to do?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:11 says, "Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God."

questions.text: If Israel made marriages with the remaining nations, what would those nations become to them?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:13 says they would be a snare and a trap, a scourge in their sides and thorns in their eyes.

questions.text: How did Joshua describe what was about to happen to him?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 23:14 he says, "Today I am going the way of all the earth."

answers.text: He was going to live among the nations
He was going the way of all the earth
He was going up to the mountain
He was going to hand the sword to Caleb

questions.text: As all the good things had come, what would Yahweh also bring on them if they disobeyed his covenant?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:15-16 says that if they disobeyed the covenant and served other gods, Yahweh would bring on them all the evil things, until he had destroyed them from the good land.

questions.text: According to Joshua, what would happen to them if they served other gods?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:16 says Yahweh's anger would be kindled and they would perish quickly from off the good land.

answers.text: They would rule over the nations
They would be given a second land
They would perish quickly from the good land
They would be sent back to Egypt
